# tools: up octosql to v0.7.1

Pin `octosql` at v0.7.1 in the Go toolset, the patch release following [#299](DOT-298.md) (v0.7.0). The tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin; the release notes are the [v0.7.1 tag](https://github.com/cube2222/octosql/releases/tag/v0.7.1). `octosql` itself was added as a "SQL for everything" experiment ([#97](DOT-96.md)).
